name: free-intelligence-film
description: A 70-second Remotion field report about the difference between model answers and accountable agent harnesses.

scripts.normalize:film: remotion ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i ../public/free-intelligence-report.mp4 -map 0 -map_metadata -1 -map_chapters -1 -c copy -fflags +bitexact -movflags +faststart -metadata creation_time=1970-01-01T00:00:00Z ../public/free-intelligence-report.normalized.mp4 && mv ../public/free-intelligence-report.normalized.mp4 ../public/free-intelligence-report.mp4
scripts.render:checkpoints: mkdir -p ../public/checkpoints && remotion still src/index.ts FreeIntelligenceReport ../public/checkpoints/frame-0090.png --frame=90 && remotion still src/index.ts FreeIntelligenceReport ../public/checkpoints/frame-0540.png --frame=540 && remotion still src/index.ts FreeIntelligenceReport ../public/checkpoints/frame-0990.png --frame=990 && remotion still src/index.ts FreeIntelligenceReport ../public/checkpoints/frame-2010.png --frame=2010
scripts.render:all: npm run render:film && npm run normalize:film && npm run render:poster && npm run render:og && npm run render:checkpoints
